measurement.method: single-image manual visual measurement from canonical target only; bounds estimated to outer visible edges of major first-level regions in native pixels
measurement.precision: integer pixel bounds for regions; normalized values rounded to 6 decimals; decorative glows/shadows excluded unless part of visible panel edge

regions.label: top navigation bar
alignment: title centered on page horizontal axis
back and menu controls vertically centered within header
left and right controls inset symmetrically from edges
spacing: ~35 px from left edge to back control
~28 px from right edge to menu control
~16 px gap from header bottom to next card

regions.label: profile summary card
internalStructure: center-left title block with main heading, pill chip, subtext
alignment: avatar slot aligned left within card
text block vertically stacked and left-aligned
right chevron vertically centered in card
spacing: ~34 px left padding to avatar outer ring
~36 px gap from avatar to text block
notes: decorative frame corners project slightly inward

regions.label: warning and next-step panel
internalStructure: gold primary button near lower left
large circular exclamation emblem on right
alignment: left text column aligned to common left inset
right circular emblem centered vertically in panel's right half
button aligned to left text column
spacing: ~42 px top padding to warning row
~28 px from warning row to headline
~31 px from divider to bullet text
~31 px from bullet text to button
notes: button and emblem occupy lower-left and right visual balance
right emblem has glow halo beyond metal ring

regions.label: four feature cards row
internalStructure: each card contains top-left badge ribbon
alignment: cards share common top and bottom edges
content within each card centered horizontally except top-left badge
spacing: ~26-30 px top padding from card edge to circular slot
notes: third card title uses Latin letters 'SimC' and slightly different vertical rhythm
all four circular slots are empty

regions.label: evidence ledger table
internalStructure: header band with icon and section title at left plus three column labels
each row contains left icon circle and label, three status cells, right action button
alignment: header labels align with underlying columns
right action buttons align vertically in a single column
spacing: ~18 px from container top to header content
notes: table bottom sits above black canvas tail
first column is much wider than numeric/status columns

regions.label: empty bottom margin
internalStructure: plain black margin without visible controls
notes: appears as empty trailing canvas area below main content

globalAlignment: major framed content regions share near-common horizontal inset: left ~20-24 px, right ~20-24 px
hero card, warning panel, and ledger table are centered within canvas and span nearly full width
main vertical flow is single-column: header -> hero card -> warning panel -> module row -> ledger table
within content panels, primary text tends to align to a left inner rail while CTA buttons align to that same rail
globalSpacing: header to hero card gap ~16 px
hero card to warning panel gap ~26 px
warning panel to module cards row gap ~26 px
module cards row to ledger table gap ~29 px
bottom of ledger table to canvas edge gap ~45 px
unresolved: exact outer bounds of subtle shadows and glow halos are intentionally excluded
fine-grained text baseline positions inside cards and rows were not measured at glyph level
some decorative frame protrusions may extend by 1-3 px beyond listed bounds
the small top-left table icon semantics are inferred as scales but textural detail is decorative, not fully resolved
